context: Tests reuse of an existing candidate list and routing a known paper straight to triage.

checklist.name: Reused the existing JSON
checklist.description: The agent reads `/tmp/prompt-compression-candidates.json` rather than running the search again.

checklist.name: Did not re-run the search script
checklist.description: The agent does not invoke `google-scholar-search.py search` for the same topic.

checklist.name: Printed the titles
checklist.description: The agent lists the candidate titles from the file.

checklist.name: Presented them as candidates
checklist.description: The agent frames the titles as candidates for the user to choose from.

checklist.name: Routed the known paper to triage-paper
checklist.description: For the arXiv URL, the agent goes straight to `triage-paper` (or offers to) without searching Google Scholar for it.

checklist.name: Did not search for the known paper
checklist.description: The agent does not run a Scholar search for the paper with the arXiv ID.

checklist.name: Did not triage the candidates automatically
checklist.description: The agent does not triage any of the saved candidates without confirmation.

checklist.name: Did not need setup or an MCP check for reuse
checklist.description: The agent does not spend time installing dependencies just to read a JSON file.

checklist.name: Offered a next step
checklist.description: The agent asks whether the user wants to triage any listed candidate.

checklist.name: Kept the two requests separate
checklist.description: The saved-search request and the known-paper request are handled as separate steps.
